title: The Three Spatial Source Cases: Where From?

sections.content:
Hungarian spatial cases form three symmetric sets corresponding to **In**, **On**, and **At**:
1. **In (Interior)**: Into *-ba/-be*, Inside *-ban/-ben*, Out of **-ból/-ből**.
2. **On (Surface / Domestic City)**: Onto *-ra/-re*, On *-on/-en/-ön*, Off of / From **-ról/-ről**.
3. **At (Person / Proximity)**: Towards *-hoz/-hez/-höz*, At *-nál/-nél*, Away from **-tól/-től**.

sections.title: The Three 'From' Cases in Contrast
rows: from an open surface or domestic city
